# Pre-registration (draft): Skip entries between 04-08 UTC for AUD/USD replica (research)

Draft written by council/trade-review.mjs on 2026-11-17 from proposal p:replica|research|weak-hours:04-08. It is not a study: it becomes one only when the owner approves it and this file is committed ALONE in research/edge/<topic>/ before any code is run. Nothing changes live on a pass (absolute rule 3): a pass is put to the owner as a proposal.

## Why it is asked
04-08 UTC: 214 trades at −0.30R a trade against −0.01R for the other 862 (difference −0.28R, t −2.83). Found on the forward record: n 214, −0.30R a trade, t −2.83, p 0.005, survives Holm over the review's split tests. In sample: found by looking at these same trades, so it proves nothing until a pre-registered test on other data confirms it. Those trades are not evidence for this test and are not reused in it; trades closed after the proposal was recorded are the review ledger's forward check (research/trade-review-ledger.json), reported apart.

## Hypothesis
- H1: AUD/USD replica's entries filled between 04-08 UTC make less R a trade after costs than its entries at other hours.
- H0: no difference.
- Variant: the rule as it is, with no entry filled between 04-08 UTC.

## Data
- 2020-01-01 → now: the council's research candles for AUD/USD replica's markets (HistData M1 read through council/histdata.mjs, OANDA where HistData has none), replayed by the rule's own code (council/trader.mjs and council/fills.mjs, imported, not copied), the last complete calendar month as the end.
- In sample 2020-01-01 to 2023-12-31; out of sample 2024-01-01 to the end. Nothing is tuned on the out-of-sample years; every parameter above is fixed now.

## Costs
- Net of the council cost model (council/fills.mjs: spread, slippage, commission, overnight financing on gold buys). The same model for the rule and the variant.
- Every trade keeps its stop (absolute rule 1); paper only.

## Test statistic
- Per calendar month, R summed after costs of the variant minus the rule as it is (the same signals, paired); t of those monthly sums, in sample and out of sample.
- Holm over every test named in this file (here one; the count rises if the owner approves several drafts as one study, and all are then corrected together).

## Pass bar
- Out of sample: n ≥ 100, mean R a trade > 0 after costs in both halves, t ≥ 2 on calendar-month sums after Holm over every test named in the pre-registration.
- And the paired difference positive in both halves.
- Reported whatever the result: n, mean R, t, by year, in sample and out of sample.
